driver_system.SetThrottleDelta(0.05)

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('PyChrono HMMWV SCM Simulation')

vis.AddSkyBox()

# 6. Simulation loop parameters
step_size = 1e-3
